# Dependencies for .github/scripts/*.py
#
# Version-pinned and hash-verified so CI installs a known artifact rather than
# whatever the index resolves to at run time. Install with:
#
#   pip install --only-binary :all: --require-hashes -r .github/scripts/requirements.txt
#
# Hashes cover both linux arches and both interpreter ABIs that can appear:
# pull_request runs use ubuntu-latest, push runs use the self-hosted
# ak-ci-runners pool. pip verifies the file it actually selects against this
# list, so listing extras is harmless.
